description: Old test identities that passed on a historical baseline and are intentionally absent from the candidate catalog. The comparison accepts an absence only when it is listed here and every successor passed in the same candidate run. A listed identity that still exists in the candidate, or that exists and fails, is never excused.

integration::test_svn_to_git_echo_suppre.reason: Same Personal SVN-to-Git echo scenario in crates/personal/tests/integration.rs, renamed when echo suppression became receipt-backed.

reposync-core::sync_engine::tests::test_.reason: The old test asserted that a delete outside the allowed paths passes validation. Validation now reports that delete as out of scope, and an in-scope delete still passes.
The old test only checked that a string contains the sync marker. Marker detection moved to the echo_suppression module, whose test checks the same marker rule through personal_mode_marker_echo.
